rules.statement: A lis pendens arises only upon the service of summons, so as to affect any dealing with the subject of litigation by the party defendant.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is not necessary for me to refer to all the authorities cited at the argument; I need only say that I agree with the decision in Perera v. Silva [(1910) 13 N. L. R. 81.] in which, upon a consideration of the principal authorities, English, Indian and Roman-Dutch, it was held that lis pendens arose only upon the service of summons, so as to affect any dealing with the subject of litigation by the party defendant."
